Parent #1202. Concrete delivery dependency of source-only #1523 / PR1621. Maximum one PR.

Actual trusted Main d416 scope job rejects declared `coordination/engineering/additive-native-gap-batch-20261008/composition-v2/README.md`; the same rule rejects the explicitly owned existing selected-neighbor-prevention helper. Engineering CLI never reads issue owned_paths and generic validation only accepts its branch-matching coordination namespace. The actual reviewed #1523 issue explicitly permits these exact paths. Do not shuffle provenance, bypass checks, hardcode an issue/PR exception, or broaden research ownership.

Implement smallest shared routing correction: engineering may edit additional coordination/engineering namespaces or exact files only when they are literal safe paths explicitly declared by the actual linked engineering work contract. Validate declared prefixes, reject namespace root/traversal/globs/duplicates and exact-file prefix confusion. Preserve existing branch namespace compatibility without a grant; preserve research/geography lane exclusions regardless of declarations. Actual CLI must parse a single valid engineering work block from its actual open type:engineering linked issue, and the PR issue binding must still match. The shared premerge reader already supplies reservation.owned_paths; ensure it follows the same path semantics. No new authority, cap, ownership claim or workflow bypass.

Acceptance: existing handoff scope tests plus meaningful real CLI fixtures demonstrate reviewed extra namespace and exact helper accepted; missing/malformed/foreign work scope, unrelated namespace, sibling prefix, research/geography paths, duplicate/unsafe broad roots refuse. Full immutable evidence/independent exact-head review/normal CI and serialized queue/readback/cleanup. No science, selected repair, provider, deployment, production or workflow changes.
